coverage: title + tagline + job relevance + 8 outcomes + 9 theory code/output blocks + 9 callouts + 2 declared figures + 1 section-specific interactive playground rendered inside Theory

top_level.attack: Contrasted against V3 roadmap and actual theory scope.
top_level.defense: Accurately names measurement/profiling, algorithmic scale and performance topics.

top_level.current_content: Reporte antes/después con el mismo resultado, dataset, hardware y límites; optimización reversible y justificada.
top_level.attack: The current lesson does not yet execute the equivalence, benchmark provenance or reversibility promised here.
top_level.defense: As a north-star contract the tagline is correct: same behavior, same workload/environment context and reversible justified optimization are exactly the right requirements.
top_level.justification: Do not weaken a sound target because the implementation currently fails to meet it; repair the lesson evidence instead.

top_level.current_content: Escalar el triage significa medir antes y después con el mismo dataset, no declarar victoria porque «se siente más rápido». En data engineering y ML ops de la región, un speedup sin same_result (resultado funcional idéntico antes y después de optimizar) o sin budget (umbral acordado de ms/memoria que el CI puede romper) es una regresión disfrazada: con n grande, el wall time se duplica. Aquí aprendes a optimizar sin saltarte la privacidad ni los tests.
top_level.attack: It correctly motivates measurement and equivalence, but the quantitative clause 'con n grande, el wall time se duplica' has no defined change in n/complexity, and it compresses several widow terms before the mechanism exists.
top_level.defense: The workplace framing and anti-regression principle are appropriate.
top_level.improved_content: Escalar el triage significa comparar una versión base y una candidata sobre **el mismo workload identificado**, no declarar victoria porque «se siente más rápido». En data engineering y ML ops, una mejora solo cuenta si el benchmark conserva el resultado funcional acordado, registra dataset, stage, entorno y muestras, y respeta un budget previamente definido. Al crecer `n`, incluso una pequeña regresión por registro puede amplificarse según la complejidad y el volumen, por eso se mide en tamaños representativos en lugar de asumir un factor fijo. La optimización tampoco puede saltarse privacidad, pruebas ni routing humano.
top_level.justification: Removes unsupported doubling and makes the job story consistent with the benchmark manifest/equivalence gate.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Perfilar wall y CPU (`perf_counter` / `process_time`) y anotar memoria con `n` explícito.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Medir wall y CPU sobre un workload identificado, distinguir RSS de asignaciones trazadas y usar `cProfile` con la estadística apropiada, verificando el mismo resultado entre corridas instrumentadas y registrando `n`/entorno.
learning_outcomes.justification: The current outcome is directionally right but omits measurement-state/equivalence and the actual memory semantics.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Medir con benchmark: warmup, mediana y una nota de variabilidad (rango o IQR simple).
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Diseñar benchmarks cold-start o steady-state explícitos, calibrar loops/valores, conservar muestras y variabilidad, y registrar fixture y fingerprint del entorno antes de comparar medianas o percentiles.
learning_outcomes.justification: Warmup/median alone do not make a tiny five-run benchmark robust.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Analizar complejidad O(n²) y medir reducción por blocking sin abandonar el recall.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Calcular costo de all-pairs y blocking desde tamaños de bloque reales, validar dominios y reportar reducción junto al candidate recall ejecutado sobre el mismo fixture etiquetado.
learning_outcomes.justification: Preserves the sound asymptotic concept while making the recall gate and remainder rows real.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Reducir candidatos con estructuras e índices invertidos antes del scorer.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Construir índices invertidos que conserven IDs y generen pares candidatos canónicos; después comparar loop/vectorización sobre ese conjunto reducido bajo un oráculo de equivalencia.
learning_outcomes.justification: The current code returns counts, not an index usable by the scorer, and vectorization is not exercised.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Aplicar dtypes estrechos, chunks y lectura columnar mínima con bound de memoria.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Usar dtypes de ancho realmente definido cuando corresponda, validar chunk size, ejecutar una proyección columnar real y distinguir payload teórico de peak/RSS medido del path.
learning_outcomes.justification: The current stdlib demo labels native C int as int32 and never performs columnar reading or a real memory bound.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Diseñar caché con invalidación por versión/cutoff y estrategia out-of-core.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Implementar `get`/miss/put con una key derivada de todas las dependencias del resultado, probar invalidación ante cambios/backfills y ejecutar un path out-of-core con working set acotado y peak medido.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current 'hit', invalidation and out-of-core behavior are strings/write checks rather than mechanisms.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Fijar performance budgets y tests de regresión que pueden fallar en CI light.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Versionar budgets sobre métricas finitas generadas por un benchmark reproducible y hacer que pytest/CI falle en runners controlados o fingerprinted, con un nightly más robusto cuando corresponda.
learning_outcomes.justification: The current scalar literals do not measure the program or fail CI.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Priorizar costo total y claridad sobre microoptimización del 2 % sin medición.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Comparar costo total y claridad mediante un reporte before/after construido desde resultados medidos, ratios válidos, equivalencia explícita y commits/configuración reversibles; rechazar microoptimizaciones sin evidencia.
learning_outcomes.justification: The principle is strong, but the current final demo uses handwritten measurements and an unsafe floor ratio.

code_blocks.title: s37_map_contract.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Returns static strings/booleans for same_result, before_after/budget, micro_only_ok and skip_privacy_or_tests.
code_blocks.current_output: case CASO-LIM-037; micro_only_ok False; skip_privacy_or_tests False
code_blocks.improved_content: Return references to a BenchmarkManifest, equivalence test result, budget result and baseline/candidate commits; derive gate status from validated artifacts rather than literals.
code_blocks.justification: A contract map is useful, but static flags do not prove its constraints.

code_blocks.title: wall_cpu_mem_cprofile.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Runs path separately for wall, CPU and tracemalloc; labels result True when two values are merely nonnegative; hot_function can only choose expensive or cheap using tottime.
code_blocks.current_output: Nonnegative predicates, n=20000, peak predicate, hot_fn expensive, hot_ok True.
code_blocks.improved_content: Reset/replay the identical fixture per instrument, compare actual outputs/checksums, record manifest and use pstats over declared tottime/cumtime rather than a two-name hardcode; add pytest regressions.
code_blocks.justification: The nominal toy passes while stateful/different outputs can false-green.

code_blocks.title: bench.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: One warmup and five single executions of a tiny sum-of-squares; prints only median/spread nonnegative predicates, n_runs and warmup=True.
code_blocks.current_output: median_ms_ok True; spread_ms_ok True; n_runs 5; warmup True.
code_blocks.improved_content: Separate cold/steady modes, calibrate loops with timeit/pyperf-style runner, persist raw samples/metadata and result checksum; report actual values without making nonnegativity the gate.
code_blocks.justification: Five tiny single-call timings are not robust benchmark evidence.

code_blocks.title: blocking_cost.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Uses floor(n/blocks) as every block size and multiplies by blocks, then divides by all_pairs.
code_blocks.improved_content: Compute from actual block sizes/IDs, validate n/blocks, and assert candidate recall plus downstream equivalence on the same fixture.
code_blocks.justification: n%blocks rows disappear from the cost model in nondivisible cases.

code_blocks.title: inv_index.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Builds city→entity IDs internally then returns only city→count and checks counts.
code_blocks.improved_content: Return keyed entity ID collections, derive canonical candidate pairs and show a post-block vectorized/loop-equivalent scoring step if vectorization is an outcome.
code_blocks.justification: Counts are not an inverted index usable by the scorer.

code_blocks.title: chunks_dtype.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Chunks a Python list; calls array('i') int32 and array('q') int64; estimates bound_bytes from list length times native-int itemsize; only prints a desired column subset.
code_blocks.current_output: chunk_sizes [3,3,3,1]; col_subset; itemsize_i32 4; bound_ok True; ok True.
code_blocks.improved_content: Validate positive chunk size, use a truly fixed-width dtype or honest native-C labels, actually construct/measure target representation and execute real column projection; distinguish payload from peak/RSS.
code_blocks.justification: The current output is platform-dependent and does not measure the list/job or columnar I/O.

code_blocks.title: cache.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: cache_put writes then returns membership, printed as hit=True; invalidation and out-of-core are returned as strings.
code_blocks.current_output: hit True; invalidate_on version_or_cutoff; ooc chunk_if_needed.
code_blocks.improved_content: Implement get-before-compute miss/hit, dependency-complete keys and explicit invalidation tests; execute bounded chunk/spill behavior for out-of-core rather than print policy labels.
code_blocks.justification: A miss followed by a write is not a cache hit.

code_blocks.title: budget.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Compares literal measured_ms=12 to budget_ms=50; no benchmark, percentile, memory/candidate budgets or pytest assertion; invalid negatives can pass.
code_blocks.improved_content: Consume validated BenchmarkResult metrics, enforce finite/nonnegative schema/units and assert all declared budgets in pytest on a controlled runner policy.
code_blocks.justification: The snippet currently demonstrates only scalar comparison, not performance regression testing.

code_blocks.title: before_after.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Uses handwritten before/after dictionaries, speedup ratio, floor-divided pair_factor and micro_only=False literal; no output equivalence or provenance.
code_blocks.improved_content: Build report from baseline/candidate BenchmarkResults under the same manifest/comparator, validate positive finite ratios, use true division for pair ratio, report reduction separately and link the optimization/rollback commit.
code_blocks.justification: The nominal exact-divisibility example hides a generic floor-division bug and invented performance evidence.

callouts.title: Gate de escala
callouts.current_content: Mismo resultado funcional + reporte antes/después con dataset/hardware/límites. Optimización reversible y justificada; no salta privacidad ni tests.
callouts.improved_content: Gate: baseline y candidato bajo el mismo BenchmarkManifest pasan el oráculo de equivalencia; el reporte guarda muestras, entorno, budgets y commits/configuración. El cambio es reversible y no puede saltarse privacidad, tests ni routing humano.
callouts.justification: The callout should express the machine-checkable gate, not only its nouns.

callouts.title: Orden: wall → cProfile → tracemalloc
callouts.current_content: `perf_counter` (wall) y `process_time` (CPU) primero, siempre con `n`. `cProfile` nombra la función caliente del pipeline. `tracemalloc` acota el pico del **path medido**. No empieces por micro-shaving (recorte minucioso de líneas sueltas) de un loop que ni siquiera es el hot path (la ruta o tramo más costoso del código).
callouts.improved_content: Empieza con elapsed wall/CPU sobre un workload identificado. Si necesitas atribución, usa `cProfile` y declara si analizas tiempo interno o acumulado; para asignaciones trazadas usa `tracemalloc`, y para el límite del proceso observa también RSS. Repite cada instrumento sobre el mismo fixture/estado y no microoptimices un tramo que el perfil no haya señalado.
callouts.justification: Avoids implying tracemalloc is RSS or cProfile returns one exact hot function automatically.

callouts.title: Sin warmup
callouts.current_content: La 1ª corrida miente. Publicar el cold start (arranque en frío) como performance del algoritmo engaña al equipo y al PR.
callouts.improved_content: No mezcles **cold start** con **steady state**. Si mides steady state, usa warmups y exclúyelos de las muestras; si el arranque en frío es el SLO, la primera ejecución es precisamente una observación que debes conservar y reportar por separado.
callouts.justification: Repairs the direct contradiction with the opening paragraph.

callouts.title: Cuenta pares y recall
callouts.current_content: La métrica de costo principal del entity resolution (ER) y el grafo es el conteo de candidatos. Si no cuentas los pares, no sabes si el blocking funciona; si no mides el recall (S30), puedes «ganar» costo y perder matches verdaderos.
callouts.justification: The callout states the correct two-sided optimization tradeoff; execution is defective elsewhere.

callouts.title: Index first
callouts.current_content: Construye el índice o la clave de blocking primero; el scorer caro opera sobre candidatos ya reducidos.
callouts.justification: Concise and technically sound ordering principle.

callouts.title: Chunk size y bound
callouts.current_content: Tradeoff overhead vs. memoria. Demasiado pequeño: overhead; demasiado grande: OOM. Mide `itemsize` y el pico; no adivines el dtype.
callouts.improved_content: Chunk size equilibra overhead y working set: valida un tamaño positivo y mide throughput/peak. Usa `itemsize` solo para la representación real y separa payload teórico de peak/RSS; no llames `int32` a un tipo nativo cuya anchura no está fijada por el contrato.
callouts.justification: The current code violates the callout's own 'do not guess dtype' rule.

callouts.title: Cache stale
callouts.current_content: Invalidar es parte del diseño. Mantén versionadas las features y el cutoff; no reutilices scores de un schema viejo.
callouts.improved_content: Invalidar es parte del diseño: la key debe cambiar cuando cambie cualquier dependencia que pueda alterar el resultado —snapshot/backfill de datos, feature/code version, preprocessing/reference, detector/policy y cutoff/as-of—. Prueba explícitamente que un cambio relevante produce miss.
callouts.justification: Version+cutoff alone can still serve stale scores after a backfill or code/model change.

callouts.title: CI light
callouts.current_content: Bench corto en PR; largo en nightly. Mismo dataset de bench; no cambies `n` en silencio.
callouts.improved_content: PR y nightly reutilizan el mismo fixture/hash y stage; registran runner/runtime y muestras. El PR usa un gate corto solo en un entorno/policy suficientemente controlado y el nightly profundiza la distribución. Ninguno cambia `n` o el workload sin versionar el benchmark.
callouts.justification: Same dataset is necessary but not enough for comparable wall-clock CI measurements.

callouts.title: Entregable
callouts.current_content: El mismo resultado, dataset, hardware y límites. Before/after legible para el revisor humano del PR.
callouts.improved_content: Entregable: baseline/candidato enlazados al mismo manifest y oráculo de equivalencia, con muestras, budgets, commits/configuración y ruta de rollback. El revisor puede reconstruir qué cambió, qué se midió y por qué el comportamiento sigue siendo aceptable.

current_content.caption: Un p95 de 5 s con media de 200 ms es un incidente de experiencia, no un pico normal.
current_content.alt: Tres barras: media, mediana y percentil 95 de latencia.

figures.improved_content: Register a figure whose bars are derived from one explicit nonnegative latency sample/distribution. Use coherent values, label the sample size/benchmark mode, and ensure mean/median/p95 are calculated from the same data.
figures.justification: The intended learner visual currently does not render; its latent numbers are also incoherent under the usual empirical p95 interpretation.

current_content.headline: Dónde se va realmente el tiempo del job
current_content.note: Optimizar antes de medir habría atacado el 21% y dejado intacto el 64%.

figures.improved_content: Either relabel every value as a hypothetical worked profile or derive the four percentages from a staged synthetic benchmark stored with its BenchmarkManifest. The caption/note must not say where time 'really' went unless a run produced the bars.
figures.justification: The arithmetic sums to 100, but no S37 benchmark measures these stages; the visual violates profile-before-optimize epistemology.

interactive_playground.current_behavior: Simulates a dbt daily_metrics model, unique/not-null tests and lineage-style concepts over transactions.
interactive_playground.improved_content: Keep the stable section id but replace this mapping with an S37 benchmark/equivalence playground: baseline and candidate over the same fixture, calibrated repetitions, before/after report and a deliberately broken same-result case the learner can detect.
interactive_playground.justification: The entire interactive activity belongs to the legacy dbt topic, not profiling/algorithms/performance.
